verses.text: For the truth that dwells in us and abides with us forever, I, the beloved, in truth for those whom I love, and not only I, but also all who know the truth, for those who love them, for the chosen mother and for her children;
Grace and mercy and peace from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ be with us in truth and love.
We have received the commandment from the Father, and I rejoice greatly for those of your children who walk in truth, for they have found it.
Now, O Mother! I beseech you that we may walk together; for this is the commandment that was from the beginning, and it is not as if I write unto you a new commandment.
As we walk according to His commandments, this is love; for from the beginning, as you have heard, this is the commandment that you should walk in.
Many deceivers have entered into the world; they do not confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
Take heed to yourselves, that you do not lose those things which you have worked for, but that you may receive a full reward.
For everyone who goes out and does not abide in the doctrine of Christ does not have God; he who abides in the doctrine of Christ has both the Father and the Son.
If anyone comes to you and does not bring this doctrine, do not receive him into your house, nor greet him;
For he who greets him shares in his evil deeds.
I desire to write to you many things; however, I do not wish to write them on paper and with ink. But I hope to come to you and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
The chosen ones, the children of your sister, greet you.
